sinopsis.es: En su cumpleaños, el joven policía Francisco Revenga es enviado a cubrir una guardia en la estepa patagónica. Durante el trayecto, se detiene en un parador donde unas imágenes comprometedoras quedan grabadas en su celular. Al descubrir que revelan una red de trata, deberá decidir hasta dónde llega su deber.
sinopsis.en: On his birthday, young police officer Francisco Revenga is sent on duty in the middle of the Patagonian steppe. During the journey, he stops for supplies at the Mustang, a combination general store and brothel. There, compromising images related to human trafficking are recorded on his cell phone. Over the next few hours, Francisco will discover the video, which will force him to make a life-altering decision.
